target_customer: Teams that use AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor to analyze business data and want shareable dashboards
problem: Analysis built through agent chats is hard to share, rerun and trust, so results need a workspace where sources, queries and code stay attached.
business_model: Subscription software with free trial, pricing not published

founders.name: Ambar Choudhury
founders.background_notes: First engineer at Forward per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building an agent connected notebook and dashboard layer over MCP is standard engineering with some hard parts around trust and reruns.

defensibility.rationale: Hex, Julius and other analytics tools can add agent workflows, and the agent connection is an open protocol.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found through 2026, though comparison pages name Hex as the established alternative.

market_need_then: Agent use for data work was rising in 2025 and 2026, but the product direction changed from healthcare back office agents to analytics, suggesting the first need was weaker.

branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN posts in June 2025 for the healthcare version and June 2026 for the analytics product.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand press, and the name was used for both the healthcare and analytics products but is similar to Byteboard, Blueboard and many others.

pivots.from: AI agents for healthcare back offices
pivots.why: Not stated, the YC launch for analytics appeared June 2026. Exact pivot date uncertain.

outcome_analysis: BitBoard began in YC Spring 2025 selling AI workers for clinic back offices, then moved to an analytics workspace for agents in 2026, with two founders ex-Forward. No funding is verified and no outcome is yet known, so the story is an early pivot into a crowded analytics space.
notes: Only funding figure is a 500K pre-seed in June 2025 on VCBacked, a single aggregator, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitor list empty because comparisons found (Hex, Julius) are 2026 listicles and the original 2025 product was healthcare agents. Pivot date inferred from launch posts. The first launch (June 2025) listed a different product from the current one.
